pages.text: $(l)Ember armor$() (Magma Shells). Full set: immune to fire and hot floors, faster on Nether grass and nylium.
$(l)Wraith armor$() (Wraith Cloth). Full set: creatures only notice you up close, and you see through ash falls.
$(l)Carapace armor$() (Basalt Carapaces). Full set: heavy knockback resistance and reflects 25% of melee damage.
